hints.text: The rule $y = 2x$ tells you how to turn any $x$ into its $y$.
$2x$ means $2$ times $x$. Put $5$ in for $x$ and work out $2 \times 5$.

explanation: The equation $y = 2x$ says that $y$ is always double $x$.
Replace $x$ with the given value $5$, which makes the rule $y = 2(5)$.
Multiplying gives $10$, so the answer is $y = 10$ when $x = 5$.
